note: Base: central glossary v2.83.0 (translation-glossary-2.83.0.json). Contents: 27 modify ops, all appliesTo extensions for the Latter-Prophets wave LP1 (jeremiah-woh 10, amos-woh 4, jonah-woh 2, zephaniah-woh 1, zechariah-woh 4, 5, 9). No new central entry, no wohChoice or rationale changed, no decision reversed, so a minor bump is recommended. Apply semantics as in the Kings, Revelation and Isaiah wave diffs: op=modify replaces each field in `changes`; appliesTo values are complete arrays preserving every refId of v2.83.0, and `appliesToAdded` lists the new refIds. CONCURRENCY: isaiah-woh wave I2 (wave-i2-central-diff.json) also targets 2.83.0 -> 2.84.0, and the Torah and Former-Prophets passes produce diffs from the same base. If any is merged first, renumber this diff to the next free minor (likely 2.85.0 or later), re-base each appliesTo array as the union (merged array + this op's appliesToAdded), and update glossaryVersion in the seven LP1 chapters. Likely overlaps: eretz, shamayim, asah, yatsar, adam-adamah, pesel-utemunah, qorbanot, chesed-solitary, bor-pit, adonai-yhwh. DELIBERATE NON-EXTENSIONS (recorded, not applied): bara (the Genesis-scoped 'shape' is NOT extended; Amos 4:13 renders bôrēʾ 'creates' under the overlay bara-create-latter-prophets, following isaiah-woh bara-create-isaiah; the Genesis 'shape' decision is under founder review from wave I2 and is not touched here); elohim-as-translation ('the Elohim' NOT extended; 'God' under the overlay elohim-god-latter-prophets, as isaiah-woh); eretz at the 'earth' sites listed in the eretz op; hevel (the personal name Abel; the common noun heḇel 'vanity' is in the overlay hevel-vanity-latter-prophets); nesekh libation entry at Jer 10:14 (nēseḵ II 'cast image', a homograph); taninim at Jer 10:22 (tannîm 'jackals'); otzrot-sheleg-barad at Jer 10:13; mlk-olam at Jer 10:10 (Ugaritic title); shut-ba-aretz at Zech 4:10 (different phrase); she-erit at Zeph 1:4 (šəʾār, not šəʾērîṯ); baal-ugaritic-baalu at Zeph 1:4; hishtachavah at Zeph 1:5 (cultic worship, not homage); mitsrayim (Amos 4:10 'Egypt', English names); bethel-luz-name-etymology (Amos 4:4 'Bethel', English names); pelishtim-caphtor (Zech 9:6 'Philistines'); adam-adamah at Zeph 1:17 (generic 'men'); malakh-yhwh-messenger is extended only for the lexeme 'messenger'.
scopeNoteAddendum: **v2.84.0 (Latter-Prophets wave LP1 — Jer 10, Amos 4, Jonah 2, Zeph 1, Zech 4, 5, 9, the canon-cited chapters of Jeremiah and the Minor Prophets):** appliesTo extensions only, for adam-adamah (+3), adonai-yhwh (+4), aluf-edomite-clan-chief-tribal-confederation (+1), arafel-thick-darkness-divine-presence-cross-corpus (+1), asah (+3), bor-pit-cistern-dry-water-shaft (+1), chesed-solitary-covenant-kindness (+1), darash-yhwh-seeking-oracle (+2), davar-yhwh-prophetic-formula (+2), eretz (+6), eretz-shinar (+1), kerem-vineyard (+2), mahapekhah-overthrowing-formula (+1), malakh-yhwh-messenger (+5), mayim (+2), mifthan-ha-bayit (+1), mizbeach-olah (+1), ototh (+1), pesel-utemunah-graven-image-iconographic-prohibition-cross-corpus (+1), qorbanot-sacrificial-offering-vocabulary-cluster-cross-corpus (+3), shamayim (+5), sheol-underworld-realm-of-the-dead (+1), tehom (+1), tzarah-distress-tribulation-vocabulary (+2), tzeva-ha-shamayim-host-of-the-heavens-divine-council-cross-corpus (+1), ulam-hekhal-devir-temple-three-room-plan-cross-corpus (+2), yatsar (+2). The five books open per-translation overlays (v1.0.0) with a shared Latter-Prophets convention set that follows isaiah-woh ('God' for ʾĕlōhîm; 'earth'/'land' by scope; lower-case 'spirit'; bārāʾ 'create'; maśśāʾ 'oracle') and the corpus rulings 'scroll', 'lampstand', 'officials' and 'shofar'. The central bara and elohim-as-translation entries are deliberately not extended.

reason: ʾāḏām / ʾăḏāmâ 'the human / the ground' (wohChoice): Zeph 1:2 ('the face of the ground'), 1:3 ('human and beast ... the human from off the face of the ground', the Gen 2:7 wordplay in a creation-reversal); Zech 9:16 ('over his ground'). The generic lāʾāḏām of Zeph 1:17 ('men') is not added. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

appliesTo extension only ('the Lord YHWH'): Amos 4:2, 5; Zeph 1:7; Zech 9:14. The compound is used outside Ezekiel, as isaiah-woh records in adonai-yhwh-compound-isaiah-25. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
appliesTo extension only: the rationale already discusses Zech 9:7; 'chief' governs the line ('like a chief in Judah'). Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
appliesTo extension only: the wohChoice already names Zeph 1:15 ('clouds and thick darkness'). Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

ʿāśâ 'made / makes' (wohChoice) in the creation and storm doxologies: Jer 10:12 ('He who made the earth'), 10:13 ('he makes lightnings'); Amos 4:13 ('who makes the morning darkness'), beside yāṣar and bārāʾ. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
bôr 'pit' (wohChoice) at Zech 9:11, 'the pit in which there is no water', the dry cistern the entry's rationale describes. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
solitary ḥeseḏ 'kindness' (wohChoice) at Jonah 2:9 ('forsake their own kindness'; ASV 'mercy'). Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
dāraš 'inquire of' YHWH: Jer 10:21 ('they have not inquired of YHWH'); Zeph 1:6 ('nor inquired of him'). Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
'the word of YHWH came to' (wohChoice): Zeph 1:1 (superscription); Zech 4:8. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

ʾereṣ rendered 'land' (wohChoice) where it is a particular territory: Jer 10:17 ('from the land'), 10:18 ('the inhabitants of the land'), 10:22 ('the land of the north'); Zech 5:3 ('the whole land'), 5:6 ('in all the land'), 9:1 ('the land of Hadrach'). Sites where the Latter-Prophets overlays render 'earth' in a cosmic or universal scope (Jer 10:10-13; Amos 4:13; Jonah 2:7; Zeph 1:18; Zech 4:10, 14; 5:9; 9:10) are governed by the overlay entry eretz-earth-or-land-latter-prophets and are NOT added. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
'the land of Shinar' (wohChoice) at Zech 5:11. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.
kerem 'vineyard' (wohChoice): Amos 4:9; Zeph 1:13. Base array is the v2.83.0 array.

appliesTo extension: the array already lists Amos 4:11 in the legacy id format 'AMOS-4:11'; the translation refId AMO-WOH-4:11 is added (legacy id kept).
